name: Dividend screen
pitch: Find stocks with a dividend coverage ratio above 100% and list the results in a table.
instructions: Search the web for business development companies with a dividend coverage ratio above 100 percent. Open enough pages to collect a list of at least five companies with their names and coverage ratios. If fewer than five are found, note how many were found and what limits were hit. Build a table with three columns: company name, dividend coverage ratio, and source URL. If no results are found, say so and list no table. When the table is ready, write the table data to a plain‑text file named dividend_screen.txt in the workspace. Do not add any commentary or extra text to the file. After writing the file, tell the person the file name and how many companies were recorded.

examples.ask: screen for companies with ratio above 100%
examples.does: search the web, collect up to five companies, show a table, write dividend_screen.txt

readme:
# Dividend screen
Finds business development companies whose dividend coverage ratio is above 100 % and saves the list to a file.

- Uses web_search to locate relevant pages.
- Shows results in a table with company name, ratio and source.
- Writes dividend_screen.txt with the table data.
- Will not pay, sign, delete or post anything.
